ITEM.PTXT: The engine control computer receives the shift position signal from the neutral start switch and transmits it to the meter computer via CAN communication.
Upon receiving this signal, the meter computer displays the currently selected shift position on the display LCD.

When the shift position "M" signal is input, the engine control computer also receives the shift switch operation (UP/DOWN) signal and transmits it to the meter computer as a CAN communication signal.
Upon receiving this signal, the meter computer illuminates the M (manual shift) mode indicator light "M" and displays the currently selected gear on the display LCD.
